Reel

↳ Posted by xurdesc on March 22nd, 2018.

Re: Sandy’s New Chanter

your third part is wrong [ from the original ], and there is a fourth part.

↳ Posted by Kenny on March 22nd, 2018.

Sandy’s New Chanter, X:8

This setting is how we play it in The Canon in Jedburgh. It’s fairly close to the original pipe setting with the main difference being that we play gBdg Bdge as opposed to gGBg Bdge in the fourth part and obviously there’s no G# in the original.
It’s one of the most joyous tunes I know.

↳ Posted by DonaldK on December 30th, 2019.

The original link is thesession.org/tunes/5208
